edit_1.before:
**CRITICAL: DO NOT auto-merge to master.**

DO NOT squash merge. ... DO NOT create a single commit on master with worktree changes. ... A proper `git merge` brings all commits to master with their original authorship and messages intact.
edit_1.after:
**CRITICAL: DO NOT auto-merge to the default branch ($DEFAULT_BRANCH).**

DO NOT squash merge. ... DO NOT create a single commit on $DEFAULT_BRANCH with worktree changes. ... A proper `git merge` brings all commits to $DEFAULT_BRANCH with their original authorship and messages intact.

[plus prepended resolver block defining $DEFAULT_BRANCH dynamically via git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD with two fallbacks]

edit_2.before:
To review changes:
  git log master..<worktree_branch> --oneline
  git diff master...<worktree_branch>
edit_2.after:
To review changes (replace $DEFAULT_BRANCH with `main` or `master` per your repo's default; resolver block earlier in this command shows how to detect it):
  git log $DEFAULT_BRANCH..<worktree_branch> --oneline
  git diff $DEFAULT_BRANCH...<worktree_branch>

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: b5d447e (regression that broke worktree-to-default-branch promotion) plus f5241eb-era hardcoding of `master` from when the project lived on a master-default repo before migrating to main
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Original dev-overnight.md was authored against master-default; project shifted to main but command was never updated. b5d447e (sweep-style sync) did not surface this because it didn't touch dev-overnight.md's master literals.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Introduces a single resolver block at the top of the relevant section that dynamically detects the default branch via `git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` (with two fallbacks). All 4 master literals replaced with `$DEFAULT_BRANCH` references. Both main-default and master-default repos work correctly.

default_branch_resolver_check.interpretation: Resolver in this `main`-default repo will resolve to `main`. In a `master`-default repo it would resolve to `master`. Final fallback is `main` only when both `git symbolic-ref` and `git remote show origin` fail (offline or detached origin), and the spec's verifier creates a throwaway `git init -b master` repo to confirm master-default works.

Without the resolver, $DEFAULT_BRANCH would be unbound when the user copies the announcement template into a shell. Total non-resolver delta: 4 lines (the 4 token replacements) — minimal.
